##### Project general facts

OXO The Pavilions is a visionary wellness living residence developed by OXO in collaboration with world-renowned architect Chris Precht of Precht Studios. This exclusive project features a collection of uniquely designed villas, each with its own floor plan, orientation, landscape, and personalized interior finishes, no two are alike. For the first time in Bali, international leaders and visionaries have come together to offer freehold ownership, ensuring complete control, security, and generational wealth for discerning investors.

Residents enjoy an unparalleled ecosystem dedicated to restoration and balance. At the heart of the property lies a stunning wellness centre featuring a sauna, ice bath, hammam, and a dream gym with high-performance fitness equipment. A wellness concierge offers personalized services including assisted stretching, guided meditation, breathwork, and nutritional guidance. The complex also features hydrotherapy pools, EV charging stations, dozens of restaurants, beach clubs, art galleries and cultural venues.

Every villa at OXO The Pavilions is a sanctuary of warmth and sophistication. Interiors feature terracotta flooring, textured paint over brick walls, bamboo or rattan lattice ceilings, and wood plank finishes. Kitchens are state-of-the-art with built-in ovens, electric stoves, premium refrigerators, and sinks with bronze finish faucets. Open-plan living areas flow effortlessly into private gardens, inviting natural light and tropical breezes. Smart home systems allow effortless control of lighting, temperature, and security, while customizable options let residents tailor their space for ultimate wellbeing.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled within Nuanu, a creative city in the Nyanyi area of Bali, this exceptional location places residents at the heart of a visionary community of creators, leaders, and changemakers. Spanning a vast natural landscape, Nuanu is designed as an integrated ecosystem where nature dominates, bringing together spaces for wellness, culture, education, art, entertainment, and nature-inspired living. The area is home to dozens of restaurants, beach clubs, galleries, and performance venues.

The location is distinguished by its perfect balance of seclusion and connectivity. Just a short drive from the iconic Tanah Lot temple and the vibrant energy of Canggu, it offers easy access to Bali's most celebrated attractions while maintaining a peaceful, immersive atmosphere. The international airport is also within comfortable reach, ensuring seamless travel for global citizens.

For those seeking a residence that embodies intention, design, and experience, Nuanu delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class amenities, creative community, and pristine natural surroundings makes it one of Bali's most desirable addresses. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of Bali, serene, inspiring and effortlessly connected.
